description: External /usr/bin/time -l readings for separate same-prepared-page-07 probe processes

measurement.process_wall_includes: startup, input/graph verification, model or session load, one warmup, two timed inference passes, parity, output write, and WebGPU separate profiling where applicable
measurement.maximum_resident_set_bytes: macOS /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size; process high-water, not device-memory total
measurement.peak_memory_footprint_bytes: macOS /usr/bin/time -l peak memory footprint; not a standalone GPU allocation measure
measurement.timed_warm_inference_is_recorded_in: the corresponding probe result JSON, not this external process wall timer
